name: Rust Canyons
description: Deep gorges carved through mountains of oxidized metal, where the walls weep orange tears and ancient machinery juts from the stone

name: Neon Wastes
description: Cracked asphalt stretches endlessly under flickering holographic billboards that advertise products for a civilization long dead

name: Chrome Gardens
description: Twisted metal sculptures and rusted vehicles overgrown with bioluminescent fungi that pulse in rhythm with unknown signals

name: Static Fields
description: Plains of crystallized sand where electromagnetic storms rage eternally, creating aurora-like displays across a toxic sky

name: Acid Rain Valleys
description: Corroded valleys where the air shimmers with chemical haze and the ground is scarred by decades of toxic precipitation

name: Data Graveyards
description: Endless fields of broken servers and dead screens, where digital ghosts flicker across corrupted displays

name: Smog Districts
description: Urban mazes of collapsed skyscrapers wrapped in perpetual fog, where visibility extends only a few meters ahead

name: Solar Flare Badlands
description: Barren expanse of glass-smooth rock formed when solar radiation melted the earth's surface into a mirror-like plain

name: Scrap Jungles
description: Towering heaps of discarded technology and machinery that have become vertical ecosystems for mutated life

name: Dead Channels
description: Dried riverbeds lined with abandoned transmission towers that still broadcast white noise to empty frequencies

name: Concrete Seas
description: Vast parking lots and abandoned highways that stretch to the horizon, cracked and split by decades of neglect

name: Virus Zones
description: Quarantined sectors where digital plagues have somehow manifested in physical space, causing reality to glitch and stutter

name: Dust Bowl Suburbs
description: Abandoned residential areas half-buried in sand, with empty swimming pools that collect rainwater and bones

name: Cybernetic Graveyards
description: Massive dumps where discarded augmentations and artificial limbs pile up like technological coral reefs

name: Ozone Holes
description: Exposed areas where the atmosphere has thinned, creating shimmering heat distortions and dangerous radiation zones

name: Ghost Networks
description: Regions where abandoned fiber optic cables snake across the landscape like luminous veins, still carrying fragments of lost data

name: Turbine Graveyards
description: Fields of massive, motionless wind turbines that stand like the bones of mechanical giants against a blood-red sky

name: Memory Palace Ruins
description: Collapsed server farms where quantum storage units leak digital memories into the physical world as holographic fragments

name: Signal Dead Zones
description: Areas of complete electromagnetic silence where no technology functions and even thoughts seem muffled

name: Chrome Deserts
description: Endless expanses of metallic sand that reflect the sun in blinding patterns, hiding the remains of a chrome-obsessed civilization

name: Verdant Sanctuaries
description: Protected groves where nature has reclaimed industrial sites, creating twisted gardens of metal trees and concrete flowers

name: Haven Settlements
description: Fortified communities built within massive shopping centers, where survivors trade solar panels and canned goods

name: Underground Railways
description: Vast subway networks that have become cities in their own right, lit by jury-rigged neon and heated by burning refuse

name: Sewer Kingdoms
description: Complex tunnel systems beneath ruined cities where outcasts have built throne rooms from pipes and electrical conduits

name: Flooded Districts
description: Partially submerged city blocks where buildings rise from murky water like concrete islands connected by makeshift bridges

name: Mutant Groves
description: Forests of genetically altered trees with bark that pulses like heartbeats and leaves that glow with stored radiation

name: Toxic Swamplands
description: Chemical marshes where the water burns with rainbow colors and the air shimmers with volatile compounds

name: Corporate Vaults
description: Sealed underground complexes where automated systems still maintain sterile environments and preserved executive offices

name: Robot Assembly Lines
description: Abandoned factories where mechanical workers continue their tasks endlessly, building products for customers who no longer exist

name: Bandit Camps
description: Ramshackle settlements built around highway interchanges, decorated with the skulls of travelers and warning signs

name: Farming Communes
description: Carefully maintained agricultural areas protected by solar-powered defensive systems and worked by extended families

name: Mining Caverns
description: Deep excavations where human and robot miners extract rare earth minerals under harsh artificial lighting

name: Maintenance Tunnels
description: Service passages that snake beneath and between structures, filled with humming machinery and pools of lubricant

name: Archive Chambers
description: Climate-controlled underground libraries where servers preserve fragments of human knowledge in crystalline storage

name: Greenhouse Domes
description: Massive glass structures where hydroponic gardens provide fresh food under the protection of force field generators

name: Scavenger Markets
description: Bustling trading posts built in stadium ruins where merchants hawk everything from pre-war electronics to synthetic meat

name: Power Plant Cores
description: Still-active energy facilities where fusion reactors hum behind radiation shielding and automated safety systems

name: Nomad Highways
description: Long stretches of intact road where traveling communities move in armored convoys between scattered settlements

name: Bunker Cities
description: Underground metropolises carved from bedrock, where families live in converted missile silos and fallout shelters

name: Tech Graveyards
description: Massive landfills of obsolete technology where scavengers search for functioning components among mountains of circuit boards

name: Purification Plants
description: Water treatment facilities that still function partially, creating oases of clean water surrounded by toxic wasteland

name: Radio Towers
description: Towering communication arrays that broadcast automated messages and serve as landmarks for wanderers across the wasteland

name: Laboratory Complexes
description: Research facilities where experiments continue autonomously, creating new horrors and wonders behind sealed blast doors

name: Vehicle Graveyards
description: Endless fields of rusted cars and trucks stacked like metal pyramids, hiding secret passages and valuable salvage

name: Garden Towers
description: Skyscrapers converted into vertical farms where each floor grows different crops under artificial suns and filtered air

name: Trade Routes
description: Well-traveled paths between settlements marked by fuel stations and defended checkpoints run by merchant guilds

name: Crystal Caves
description: Natural caverns filled with mineral formations that store and amplify electromagnetic signals from the surface world

name: Diplomatic Zones
description: Neutral territories where different factions meet to negotiate, built in the shells of old government buildings

name: Quarantine Sectors
description: Walled districts where dangerous experiments are contained, patrolled by automated security drones and warning systems

name: Salvage Yards
description: Organized collections of useful debris run by families who know exactly where to find any component or material needed

name: Refinery Districts
description: Industrial zones where crude materials are processed into usable resources by a combination of human workers and automated systems
